item.title: Holy Moly: Affordable Housing Proposed for Catholic Center
item.description: A Brooklyn-based affordable housing developer is seeking to expand its Buffalo footprint. BFC Partners has offered to purchase the Diocese of Buffalo’s Catholic Center complex located at the northeast corner of Main and Goodell streets. The purchase offer of $4.5 million, substantially less than the $9.8 million sought by the diocese, is subject to approval by the U.S. Bankruptcy Court which is overseeing the diocese’s Chapter 11 case.
